reviews.t: Great addition for the Cora Cup!
reviews.x: This is a really nice add to keep my Cora Cup clean and sanitized. It doesn't have an over powering scent nor does it feel goopy or over soapy. It also doesn't leave behind a residue which was what I initially worried about. The instructions are easy to understand. I would recommend this.

reviews.t: Ok, but perhaps not for me.
reviews.x: I would say it is highly fragrant but does feel luxurious. It was nice but perhaps not the best I have used. I was honestly expecting more for the price, as in keep me moisturized and feeling fresh longer but it was not the case. I actually felt more dry than with my current wash.

I was looking for a ph balancing wash (not for the private area but for sweat) and stumbled across this one. I love the scent and how it foams up. The wash also helps me stay fresh longer.  Note: I do NOT use this wash as a vaginal wash. Only as a body wash

Cora One Wash has a gentle lather with a refreshing scent of lavender and the beach. It leaves skin feeling clean and smelling fresh. I like that it is gentle on my skin and that it has pure and natural ingredients. It’s safe to use on your whole body.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the light, citrusy scent and find it pleasant and not overpowering.
The packaging and twist/pop-up cap are frequently praised for making dispensing easy and preventing leaks.
Several reviewers find the wash gentle and softening, suitable for sensitive skin and all-over body use.
Some reviewers report irritation or stinging, especially in intimate areas, and say it is not for sensitive skin.
A few reviewers dislike the texture and lather, noting it doesn't foam much and can leak or drip from the cap.
